purpose: Lets the person find and pick one option from a long list by typing to filter it. Use it when the options pass about ten or need search.

notFor.case: A short list of options that can all be shown at once.
Several open-ended values the person invents.
Free text with no list of options.
A menu of actions rather than a value to choose.

Default.visual: Surface/input box with a Border/control edge; value in Content/primary, placeholder and icons in Content/subtle.

Focused.visual: Border/focus edge with a Border/ring/default halo.

Open.visual: As Focused (Border/focus with Border/ring/default), with the ComboboxPopover below.

Invalid.visual: Status/critical/border-strong edge with a Status/critical/border halo.

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill; value, placeholder and icons in Content/disabled.

Loading.visual: The Default look with a spinner in place of the chevron.

a11y.role: combobox (editable, list autocomplete) with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant
a11y.keyboard: Typing filters and opens the list. Arrow Down / Up open it when closed and move the active option when open; Enter picks it; Escape closes the list and clears the query. Focus stays in the field; leaving it closes the list.
notes: Keep a visible label (Field) and expose the error through aria-describedby.
The edge moves with use-hover and the halo with use-focus.

openQuestions: Short lists: the usage says a plain Select is enough for short lists, but there is no Select component. Which component should short lists use?
Free text: if the typed text matches no option, is it kept as the value, or cleared on blur?
Reduced motion: should the edge and halo transitions be instant, and the popover appear with no motion?
